rule: Show one visible focus first, keep deeper build layers available only when the user asks.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or booking commission route is handled by Heavyster in phase one.

buyer.visible_focus: Use the cleanest visible supply path.
buyer.next_action: Open buyer desk or copy one direct enquiry

supplier.visible_focus: List one machine with proof and freshness.
supplier.money: USD 9 monthly or USD 99 yearly per active listing
supplier.next_action: Open supplier desk or route one lead

founder.visible_focus: Grow one market wedge only when it stays calm.
founder.proof: Demand, proof, listing ARR, and supply gap visible
founder.money: Listing ARR first; no rental custody
founder.next_action: Open market command or supplier hunt

acceptance: Marketplace opens with Calm Focus Lens visible before deeper route layers.
Deeper route layers are collapsed by default and can be revealed with Show build layers.
Buyer, supplier, and founder focus models each show one visible focus, one proof reason, one money rule, and one next action.
Copy focus includes the direct supplier payment guardrail and 0% rental take.
Build Phase includes the Calm Focus Lens contract and version record.
